summary: Iteration 10: Frontend-only testing of legal pages routing, footer navigation, Register T&C checkbox gating and BECS DDR checkbox gating on Payment Plan. All 9 requested scenarios passed end-to-end. Admin login also validated.
critical_code_review_comments: LegalPage.jsx correctly derives section from location.pathname.split('/').pop() and defaults to 'privacy' on unknown paths — robust fallback.

Register.jsx uses disabled={loading || !acceptedTerms} which correctly gates the submit button; Terms/Privacy links use target=_blank with rel not set — consider adding rel="noopener noreferrer" for security when opening /legal/* in new tabs.

PaymentPlanPage.jsx correctly hides becs-info-banner and becs-agree-checkbox when paymentType !== 'au_becs_debit'; topup buttons disabled via (paymentType === 'au_becs_debit' && !becsAgreed). Works as expected.
LegalPage nav uses plain <button> — already has data-testid. No issues.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded customer bills for payment plan verification)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 requested features are working: (1) /legal/privacy, /legal/terms, /legal/becs all render correct titles & sections; (2) in-page tabs legal-nav-privacy/terms/becs switch content & URL; (3) footer-privacy-link/footer-terms-link/footer-becs-link on LandingPage navigate correctly; (4) Register submit is disabled initially, enabled only when register-terms-checkbox is checked, disabled again on uncheck; (5) Register terms links have target=_blank and point to /legal/terms and /legal/privacy; (6) Payment Plan BECS banner+checkbox only appear when payment-type-becs is selected, hidden after switching back to card; (7) All four stripe-topup buttons (small/medium/large/custom_plan) are disabled while BECS selected & checkbox unchecked, enabled after checking, disabled again after unchecking; (8) Admin login redirects to /admin dashboard, Customer login redirects to /dashboard. Minor enhancement suggestion: add rel="noopener noreferrer" to target=_blank links on Register page.
